svg.aria-label: Each phase opens only when its gate criteria hold
svg.font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Each phase opens only when its gate criteria hold

g.text: Phase 1 · Grounded core
Prove a resume can be tailored with zero invented claims
Upload PDF, DOCX or pasted text
Vault with quoted facts and a review screen
JD paste and all nine Tailor stages
Every deterministic check plus the judge
PDF export and Stripe billing
One D1 control plane, default jurisdiction
Gate: zero unsupported claims on the regression set; p95 first draft under 90 s
Phase 2 · Agentic depth
Help users surface more true experience and refine faster
Interviewer mode and gap questions
Chat refinement with bullet caching
DOCX export and LinkedIn import
EU vaults and EU R2 buckets
Application tracker
Seeded-fabrication catch rate per release
Gate: EU residency verified end to end; export and erasure audited
Phase 3 · Teams and reach
Extend the same guarantee to new outputs and new buyers
Coach and organization seats with sharing grants
Cover letters under the same checks
Interview prep pack built from citations
MCP server: bring your vault to other AI tools
Regional control-plane shards if needed
Gate: counsel sign-off on consent and notices; cards pass a re-identification test
Phase 4 · Marketplace beta, US
Prove recruiters pay to meet consenting, evidence-backed candidates
Notify me and Anonymous visibility levels
Index shards, req sessions, intro threads
Credits held at request, used on acceptance
Verified agencies first; brokered introductions
Fairness metrics and bias-audit tooling
NYC, Colorado, California, Illinois notices
Gate: acceptance and complaint rates on target; bias audit published; FCRA position confirmed
Phase 5 · Evidence and partners
Make verification the reason recruiters choose this pool
Attestations and credential checks
Open visibility level
Placement-fee plans
ATS connectors and the partner API
Job boards, outplacement and school cohorts
Saved searches and alerts
Gate: AI Act Annex III provider obligations met for the ranking; DPIA approved
Phase 6 · EU recruiter side
Open ranked search to EU candidates and organizations under the AI Act
Annex III provider file and EU registration
Transfer terms for organizations outside the EEA
EU candidates discoverable in EU shards
Human-oversight tools for deployers
Post-market monitoring
